items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Well I’m the one that started him singing, with my band.

ctx.x: A funny man. You two must be something together, that’s all I can say.
Well I’m the one that started him singing, with my band.

items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: So you had a whole different group of people to work with including Jack Sheldon.

ctx.x: A lot of places to park, that’s one thing. A lot of parking places.
This is important. So you had a whole different group of people to work with including Jack Sheldon.

Well I had a lot of friends who already had preceded me to California. The whole Merv Griffin band was out there and I knew all those guys. And other musicians that had moved to California. It was good to be back with them again. But you’re right, I met all the west coast gang and that was terrific. I loved that part of my life. I had a great time in L.A. Although I didn’t like living in L.A. as a place to live. I thought it was a malignant environment. I hated it. But many adventures and many happy memories.
